verdict.rationale: FireHydrant offers a documented full REST API ('anything you can do on the UI' including defining incidents, configuring integrations) plus an official MCP server, and Signals/Alerts support acknowledgment and escalation via policies/schedules — giving an agent plausible end-to-end programmatic paths to acknowledge, escalate, and resolve. However, there is no evidence detailing specific API/MCP endpoints for acknowledging alerts or resolving incidents step-by-step, nor any hands-on account of an agent performing this end-to-end without dashboard involvement. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoint documentation for acknowledge/escalate/resolve actions, independent or hands-on verification of an agent completing the full loop without UI.
